normalization_decisions: Definition hash metadata is nested in sha256; store master is ID-to-name while CSV has two columns. Alias headers are product_label/store_label. These are schema adapters only.
sales_jpy = gross_jpy; refunds_jpy = refunds_jpy; net_sales_jpy = net_jpy. Change rate is a fraction, multiplied by 100 and rounded to oracle two decimals.

adopted=accepted; excluded_duplicate=exact_duplicate; held_conflict=conflicting_duplicate; held_invalid_numeric with blank raw quantity=missing_quantity; held_unknown_product/store and held_unmatched_return map to their semantic exclusions; held_return_excess uses the independent oracle quantity cap.
Old sales README, notes and derived manifest hashes are historical; current baseline is authoritative. Every numerical CSV must match old oracle unchanged.
Source quotes compare exact physical line content, ignoring only terminal CR/LF. Per-file inventory supplies hash linkage where per-source hashes are absent.
